name: cash_flow_30_60_90
query:
SELECT
  bd.customer AS `customer`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN bd.outstanding_amount > 0 AND bd.due_date < CURDATE()
           THEN bd.outstanding_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `overdue`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN bd.outstanding_amount > 0 AND bd.due_date >= CURDATE()
            AND bd.due_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
           THEN bd.outstanding_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `due_0_30`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN bd.outstanding_amount > 0
            AND bd.due_date > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
            AND bd.due_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 60 DAY)
           THEN bd.outstanding_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `due_31_60`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN bd.outstanding_amount > 0
            AND bd.due_date > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 60 DAY)
            AND bd.due_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
           THEN bd.outstanding_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `due_61_90`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN bd.outstanding_amount > 0
            AND bd.due_date > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
           THEN bd.outstanding_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `due_over_90`,
  SUM(bd.outstanding_amount) AS `outstanding_total`
FROM `tabBatch Debt` bd
WHERE bd.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY bd.customer
ORDER BY `outstanding_total` DESC
